'''Kilo Detton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who supported the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he tasked an Imperial spacer to use a data spike to plant a virus in the top secret [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military databanks at the enemy's [[Republic broadcast tower|broadcast tower]].<ref name="TOR:Backdoor" />
